title: Kidspace Children's Museum

services.name: field trips
services.desc: Kidspace in Pasadena happily welcomes school visits through our group admission program. A limited number of unguided group visits are available each week by advanced reservation. During your unguided visit, students can explore interactive exhibits focused on science, nature, and gross motor play, providing a hands-on learning environment that supports California educational standards. To reserve a school or group visit, please contact Kidspace customer service or reach out for more information. services.name: Spring and Summer Day Camps
services.desc: Summer Camp runs every week from June 8 through August 7 except for the week of June 29. Space is limited. Not a member? Join today! Each week will bring to life a different National Park with new camp mascots, trail names, and challenges, plus up-close experiences with live animals, campfire singalongs, water play days, and all the summer fun of Kidspace Museum. Camps run weekly all summer. Each camp is five full days at Kidspace, Monday through Friday, from 8:45 am to 3:00 pm, and designed to delight children 5-8 years old.
